# Contributing to CoeurDesire

Thank you for your interest in contributing to CoeurDesire! We welcome contributions that help make this luxury beauty and wellness experience even better.

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/CoeurDesire.git`
3. Install dependencies: `npm install`
4. Create a branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name`
5. Start the dev server: `npm run dev`

## Development Guidelines

- Follow the existing code style (TypeScript, React functional components)
- Keep components focused and under 200 lines
- Use Framer Motion for animations — stay consistent with existing transitions
- Match the luxury aesthetic: soft tones, elegant typography, minimal clutter
- Write meaningful commit messages

## Submitting Changes

1. Ensure `npm run build` passes without errors
2. Push your branch and open a Pull Request
3. Fill out the PR template completely
4. A maintainer will review within a few days

## Reporting Issues

Use the [issue templates](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) to report bugs or request features.

## Code of Conduct

Please read our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) before contributing.
